items.headline: Can Week 8 up the ante again with more upsets and drama?
items.description: With plenty of SEC drama last week, could Week 8 bring even more chaos?

items.headline: Air Force takes on Wyoming in MWC action
items.description: Air Force (5-1) at Wyoming (4-3), Oct. 23 at 9 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Tyler Hughes totals 379 yards on offense and Wyoming dumps Northern Illinois 41-23
items.description: — Tyler Hughes compiled 379 yards of total offense and scored four rushing touchdowns to lead Wyoming's 41-23 victory over Northern Illinois on Saturday.

items.headline: Ranking college football's best 60 receivers of the last 50 years
items.description: As Jeremiah Smith continues to amaze, Bill Connelly looks at where his career fits among the best ever.

items.headline: Erik Sandvik makes FG in OT as Wyoming beats San Jose State 16-13 to snap 8-game road losing streak
items.description: — Tyler Hughes threw for a touchdown and ran for 92 yards, Erik Sandvik made a short field goal in overtime and Wyoming beat San Jose State 16-13 on Friday night to snap an eight-game road losing streak.

items.headline: San Jose State hosts Wyoming in MWC play
items.description: Wyoming (2-3) at San Jose State (3-2), Oct. 9 at 9 p.m. EDT.
